# m.partners.etf_global.analytics

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

ETF Global's quantitative risk, reward, and quality scores for US-listed ETFs.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.etf_global.analytics(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`, `EffectiveDate` and `ProcessedDate`

[Dataset index](README.md)

| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | ETF tickers; None, the default, for no ticker filter (`dm.ALL` is refused). |

| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

- ETF Analytics (REST): Available to existing subscribers only. Updated daily.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol used to identify this ETF product on exchanges." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. |
| `QuantCompositeBehavioral` | double | Behavioral analysis score measuring investor psychology and market behavior patterns. |
| `QuantCompositeFundamental` | double | Overall fundamental analysis score combining P/E, P/CF, P/B, and dividend yield metrics. |
| `QuantCompositeGlobal` | double | Overall global theme score combining sector and country analysis for macro investment views. |
| `QuantCompositeQuality` | double | Overall quality assessment score combining liquidity, diversification, and issuing firm factors. |
| `QuantCompositeSentiment` | double | Overall market sentiment score combining put/call ratios, short interest, and implied volatility. |
| `QuantCompositeTechnical` | double | Combined technical analysis score aggregating short, intermediate, and long-term technical factors. |
| `QuantFundamentalDiv` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on dividend yields of the ETF's underlying securities. |
| `QuantFundamentalPb` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on price-to-book value ratios of the ETF's holdings. |
| `QuantFundamentalPcf` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on price-to-cash-flow ratios of the ETF's underlying assets. |
| `QuantFundamentalPe` | double | Fundamental analysis score based on price-to-earnings ratios of the ETF's underlying holdings. |
| `QuantGlobalCountry` | double | Quantitative score analyzing global country themes and country-specific market factors. |
| `QuantGlobalSector` | double | Quantitative score analyzing global sector themes and sector-specific performance factors. |
| `QuantGrade` | String | Letter grade summarizing the ETF's overall quantitative assessment, where A = 71-100, B = 56-70, etc. |
| `QuantQualityDiversification` | double | Quality assessment score evaluating the diversification benefits and risk distribution of the ETF. |
| `QuantQualityFirm` | double | Quality assessment score evaluating the reputation and capabilities of the ETF's issuing firm. |
| `QuantQualityLiquidity` | double | Quality assessment score measuring the liquidity characteristics and trading ease of the ETF. |
| `QuantSentimentIv` | double | Market sentiment score derived from implied volatility levels in options markets. |
| `QuantSentimentPc` | double | Market sentiment score derived from put/call option ratios and options activity. |
| `QuantSentimentSi` | double | Market sentiment score based on short interest levels and short selling activity. |
| `QuantTechnicalIt` | double | Intermediate-term technical analysis score evaluating medium-term price trends. |
| `QuantTechnicalLt` | double | Long-term technical analysis score assessing extended price trend patterns. |
| `QuantTechnicalSt` | double | Short-term technical analysis score based on recent price movements and trading patterns. |
| `QuantTotalScore` | double | ETF Global's comprehensive quantitative analysis score combining all quantitative factors. |
| `RewardScore` | double | ETF Global's proprietary Green Diamond score measuring the potential reward and return prospects of the ETF. |
| `RiskCountry` | double | A component score assessing country-specific risks based on the ETF's geographic exposure. |
| `RiskDeviation` | double | A component score measuring how much the ETF deviates from expected performance. |
| `RiskEfficiency` | double | A component score assessing the operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness of the ETF. |
| `RiskLiquidity` | double | A component score measuring the liquidity risk and ease of trading the ETF. |
| `RiskStructure` | double | A component score evaluating risks related to the ETF's structural design and mechanics. |
| `RiskTotalScore` | double | ETF Global's proprietary Red Diamond overall risk assessment score for the ETF. |
| `RiskVolatility` | double | A component score measuring the volatility risk of the ETF's price movements. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
